purpose: Improve the active whole-site UI/UX plan through observed public journeys and official documentation with explicit adoption decisions.

method.selection: Purposive sample of six affinity tools and one Spanish programme comparator; no ranking, exhaustive market survey or usability study.
method.inspection: Official web search/reader plus fresh isolated Playwright contexts. Browser integration unavailable; owner browser profile never used.
method.fixturePolicy: No owner opinions, login, email or saved result. Wahl-O-Mat alone received uniform synthetic neutral responses to inspect weighting/selection.
method.artifactPolicy: Raw text and screenshots stay in ignored .tools/affinity-reference-research; this record contains original paraphrases, source URLs, limits and our design decisions.
method.verificationLimits: No site certified accessible/private/accurate. Blocked and unfinished traversals remain explicit; documented results never relabelled as observed.

sites.name: Wahl-O-Mat

observations.claim: Direct start; one statement with three choices, separate skip and progress. The synthetic fixture reached weighting review and party selection.
The FAQ describes result tuning, comparison of up to three parties, statement explanations grouped by position and party-specific reading. Equal percentages can conceal different agreements.

sites.critique: Useful paths after results. Its oversized inspected masthead uses substantial question space; seat-based ordering and party-selection prerequisites do not fit our full-set results.
sites.limits: Result tools were documented, not exercised. No general accessibility or privacy audit.

inspection.fixture: Uniform synthetic neutral answers; no owner opinions, account or saved result.

sites.name: StemWijzer
sites.edition: Netherlands Tweede Kamer 2025; current FAQ also covers municipal 2026

observations.claim: The question shows progress, learn-more and party-position controls and a marked unfamiliar term. Desktop and mobile question screens were inspected.
The FAQ describes a result matrix and optional additional statements for some close results, and separates position answers from issue importance.

sites.critique: Contextual help is useful. Party-position reveal during answering would break our identity boundary. Extra questions must not manufacture a winner.
sites.limits: No answers/results submitted. Opening learn-more timed out; expanded help is not claimed.

sites.name: smartvote International
sites.edition: Public demonstration; not a current election source

observations.claim: Home, Matching and Database are separate; the homepage explains three stages. The inspected database had candidate/party tabs and an election selector, but remained an initial loading shell.
Methodology distinguishes matching from radar and political-map projections with selected questions and dimensions.

sites.critique: Independent public browsing transfers well. Our factsheets need programme facts, not a candidate database or newly invented radar axes.
sites.limits: Terms accepted only in an isolated demo without login/opinions. Start-now timed out; no questionnaire/result/profile detail claimed.

inspection.fixture: Fresh isolated context; no political answers.

sites.name: RTVE programme comparator

observations.claim: Choose topics, then programmes; read parallel topic summaries with full-programme links. Housing with PSOE and PP was exercised after rejecting cookies.
At 390px in this inspection, topic icons and party selectors overlapped and two prose columns became difficult to scan. Desktop programme headings remained visible.

sites.critique: Topic-first and parallel reading are useful. A desktop-column copy would reproduce the observed narrow-layout weakness. Our complete formation/citation scope remains distinct.
sites.limits: A comparator, not matching evidence. Its summaries were not audited or imported into our electoral bank.

inspection.fixture: Housing and two programmes only for layout inspection.

sites.name: iSideWith

observations.claim: A terms/privacy modal covered entry. Underlying quiz markup showed topic groups, learn-more, alternative stances and show-more questions.
FAQ explains stance alternatives and importance; editorial standards describe candidate/party/ideology matching and voluntary-response polling.

sites.critique: Contextual explanation transfers. Long forms and stats/discussion controls compete with the novice task; additional stance generation, ideology labels and polling do not fit this bank.
sites.limits: Consent not accepted; no answers, result or expanded stance flow exercised.

sites.name: Vote Compass

observations.claim: Overview separates editions, explains survey-to-results and advertises a dashboard and social comparison.
Methodology distinguishes alignment bars from ideological projections and weighting. Policy alignment is not a voting prediction.

sites.critique: Explain each measure separately. Profile sharing and copied ideological charts fall outside our privacy/scoring scope.
sites.limits: Results supported by published documentation, not a completed live dashboard. No privacy assurance transferred.

sites.name: EU&I 2024
sites.edition: European Parliament 2024, including Spanish country entry

observations.claim: Official introduction describes 30 statements, country selection, and comparison within a country or across Europe.

sites.critique: Scope needs clear naming. Our single historical Congress edition does not require a country/constituency gate or European source substitution.
sites.limits: Web reader retrieved introduction; isolated browser was blocked and methodology link failed. No visual or interactive result conclusion.

decisions.title: Find a proposal without doing the test
decisions.change: Local all-80 proposal search; count/page/no-hit recovery and same-proposal transfer.
decisions.constraint: No prerequisite party/location, stored query or personalized request.

decisions.title: Compare two/three programmes from a revealed result
decisions.change: Unchecked result-row choices, bounded selection summary, explicit workspace entry and exact result return.
decisions.constraint: No top-party preselection, order/score change or recommendation.

decisions.title: Find documented differences and missing information
decisions.change: All / different documented values / information missing views; +1/+2 count, mixed rows can appear in both views.
decisions.constraint: Equal values do not imply identical conditions; gaps never become zero/opposition; no affinity recomputation.

decisions.title: See your own answer beside programme positions after finish
decisions.change: Compact explicitly requested own-answer line, with truthful unsure/skip/unasked and version invalidation.
decisions.constraint: Hidden before finish; off by default; no personalized URL/fetch or fourth-party column.

decisions.title: Reconsider one answered proposal
decisions.change: Direct review from example; preserve question set and other answers; invalidate personal views; finish deliberately again.
decisions.constraint: No live tuning while answering, rerun starters, altered weights or automatic reveal.

decisions.title: Explain equal, close and surprising totals
decisions.change: Unnamed equal-total example with different agreements; result help leads to evidence and comparison.
decisions.constraint: No tie-breaking contest, ideological prediction, precision promise or changed 20 + 10 journey.

decisions.title: Explain an unfamiliar word where it appears
decisions.change: Short neutral touch/click/keyboard definition and exact return; audit in copy ledger.
decisions.constraint: No hover-only access, party priming, new answer or changed authored meaning.

decisions.title: Keep one interpretable calculation and a private session
decisions.change: Retain overlap plus evidence information; exclude radar/ideology maps, profile sharing, opinion feeds and collection/account gates.
decisions.constraint: References are UX context only; no foreign positions or second matching model.

decisions.title: Offer a small verified formation factsheet
decisions.change: Official name, 2023 availability, constituency facts, original document and useful topic/comparison/return actions.
decisions.constraint: All 59; no seat priority, biography/verdict, inheritance or default programme essay.

decisions.title: Bound attention and navigation on narrow screens
decisions.change: Concrete navigation/disclosure budgets; bounded lists and actual real-text narrow/low-height/zoom critique.
decisions.constraint: Never meet budgets by hiding conditions, shrinking type, consent gating or claiming measured speed.

planGapsResolved: Result-to-comparison was not a connected acceptance flow.
Signed-opposition-only filter missed qualified same-direction differences.
Own-answer overlays lacked a precise screen/invalidation contract.
Equal totals lacked an example of different agreement sets.
Revision from a cited example and factsheet returns needed bounded paths.
retainedStrengths: Direct quiz start and accepted answer/transition behavior
Memory-only private state and deliberate result reveal
All 59 with missing common programmes visible
One-topic comparison and semantic source return
prototypeScope: Original comparison prototype unchanged. Added result transfer, overlays, revised filters, search and examples remain planned and need their own sketch/prototype and application evidence.
